title: CreateWorldUICompatibility
body:
# CreateWorldUI Compatibility
## 🌟 Overview
This resource pack enhances the visual experience of **CreateWorldUI** by adding full compatibility with **ClearMyBackground**.  
When all three are used together, the 1.7.10 world creation screen gains a **1.20.5+‑style look**, combining a panoramic background with clean, transparent tab buttons.

It’s a small pack, but it completes the modern UI experience that CreateWorldUI aims to bring to classic Minecraft.

---

## ✨ What This Pack Adds
- **Transparent tab buttons** styled after modern versions  
- **Visual adjustments** to match ClearMyBackground’s panoramic world‑creation view  
- **A unified, modern look** that blends CreateWorldUI’s layout with high‑version aesthetics  
- **A closer match to Minecraft 1.20.5+**, rather than the 1.17–1.20.4 style CreateWorldUI alone provides

---

## 📦 Requirements
- **[CreateWorldUI](https://modrinth.com/project/dCSw6pVW)**  
- **[ClearMyBackground](https://github.com/RuiXuqi/ClearMyBackground)**  
(Using all three together unlocks the full visual upgrade.)

---

## 🎨 Why Use This Pack?
If you want your 1.7.10 world creation screen to look like **the newest versions of Minecraft**, this pack completes the transformation—bringing panoramic visuals, transparency, and a cleaner modern feel.
